goal_amendment.proposal: one deterministic fixed-binary constraint-local HZ LP with phase-boundary dual pivots and persistent HiGHS bound flips
goal_amendment.final_authority_unchanged: raw_BOX plus verifier-owned zero-width forward replay plus exact stored-binary64 property replay

logical_screen_correction.finding: lack of a complete pivot guarantee is not by itself a rejection reason because the path is candidate-only and every failure may return UNKNOWN
remaining_admission_requirements: all fixed cells retain exact binary phase semantics

representation_check.semantic_caveat: fixed binaries make the stored HZ model one exact phase assignment, but the outward numerical-error factors and HiGHS tiny-coefficient candidate copy mean its LP polytope is not asserted bit-identical to the composed input-factor LP; it remains candidate-only and requires final replay

first_unknown_cifar100_medium_iid0.phase_boundary_rule: inactive phase uses a basis-active lower sign row; active phase uses the basis-active lower bound of its normalized ReLU output factor; select largest absolute dual and break ties by binary position
first_unknown_cifar100_medium_iid0.decision: the corrected walk is real and cheap after the first basis, but it stalls strictly negative on the first capability target

hostile_selection_control.finding: ranking raw Big-M branch-row or fixed-binary marginals without requiring an active phase boundary selects binary 1249 and an empty neighboring cell
hostile_selection_control.decision: the boundary filter is semantic, not a tunable fallback

decision.unknown_ceiling_census_reason: the single-pair performance gate and first official UNKNOWN capability gate already failed, so a 357-instance expansion could not authorize this implementation
decision.reason: the route validates the proposed warm bound-flip mechanism but fails the first performance gate even under an impossible lower bound and adds no verdict on the first official UNKNOWN
decision.reopen_condition: a representation that constructs the same fixed-cell walk model and its first usable basis below the retained path by enough margin to pass the preregistered response gates
